subject: CS230
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering all topics. For English, top-tier channels like Web Dev Simplified, Computerphile, and Coding with John were chosen for their clarity and high engagement. For Arabic, selections from highly-regarded educational channels like Hassouna Academy, Adel Nasim, and TheNewBaghdad provide comprehensive and practical explanations. In several cases, especially for Arabic, many candidates were filtered for being part of a series, too theoretical, or having low views, but strong standalone videos were found for each topic.

coverage.note: Many candidates were parts of a series; a standalone comprehensive tutorial was preferred.
Many candidates were shorts or had low views. Selected video on C's strtok() perfectly illustrates the topic's challenges.
Only one candidate was highly relevant and had significant views.
Many candidates were shorts or had low views.
Many candidates focused only on ASCII, not Unicode.

videos.title: Learn Regular Expressions In 20 Minutes
videos.filter_reason: A perfectly paced, highly-viewed tutorial that clearly explains the core concepts of Regex in a practical context.

videos.title: How to split strings in C (strtok)
videos.filter_reason: This video's focus on C's tricky strtok() function perfectly illustrates the stateful parsing and edge cases students struggle with.

videos.title: Java Strings are Immutable - Here's What That Actually Means
videos.topic_ar: عدم قابلية تغيير السلاسل النصية وإدارة الذاكرة
videos.filter_reason: An outstanding explanation with excellent visuals that clarifies how strings are stored in memory and what immutability truly means.

videos.title: Java substrings are easy! 📧
videos.filter_reason: Uses a practical 'email slicer' example that effectively demonstrates the use of indexOf and substring to solve a real problem.

videos.title: Characters, Symbols and the Unicode Miracle - Computerphile
videos.filter_reason: A classic, highly engaging explanation from Computerphile that masterfully explains the 'why' behind Unicode, making the abstract concept tangible.

videos.title: Regular Expressions in 30 minutes (Arabic)
videos.filter_reason: A comprehensive, standalone 30-minute tutorial that provides a practical, from-scratch guide to using regular expressions.

videos.title: سي شارب C# SPLIT STRING   VISUAL STUDIO #067
videos.filter_reason: This highly-viewed video clearly explains the C# split() method, a common tool for tokenization, in a very practical and easy-to-follow manner.

videos.title: 5- Mutable and Immutable Object
videos.topic_ar: عدم قابلية تغيير السلاسل النصية وإدارة الذاكرة
videos.filter_reason: This is the most relevant Arabic video, clearly explaining the core concept of mutable vs. immutable objects and memory with high viewership.

videos.title: #029 [JAVA] - String & Array String
videos.filter_reason: An extremely popular and comprehensive tutorial on Java strings that covers all the key manipulation methods like substring and indexOf in detail.

videos.title: Code ASCII-UNICODE
videos.filter_reason: A highly-viewed and comprehensive lecture that covers both ASCII and Unicode, providing a solid academic foundation for the topic.
